title: Senior Data Scientist
description: We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our AI team. You will build and deploy machine learning models, conduct statistical analyses, and drive data-driven decisions. Experience with Python, ML frameworks, and cloud platforms is required.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Join our engineering team to build scalable web applications. You will work on both frontend (React) and backend (Node.js) systems. Strong understanding of REST APIs, databases, and modern JavaScript required.

title: NLP Engineer
description: Seeking an NLP Engineer to develop cutting-edge natural language processing solutions. You will work on text classification, named entity recognition, and language model fine-tuning using transformers.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Looking for a DevOps Engineer to build and maintain our CI/CD infrastructure. You will manage Kubernetes clusters, automate deployments, and ensure system reliability using AWS and Terraform.

title: Data Analyst
description: We need a Data Analyst to transform data into actionable insights. You will design dashboards, write complex SQL queries, and present findings to stakeholders using Tableau and Power BI.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Build and deploy production ML systems at scale. You will work on feature pipelines, model training, A/B testing, and MLOps infrastructure using GCP and Kubernetes.

title: Backend Python Developer
description: Join our backend team developing high-performance APIs. You will build Django REST framework applications, optimize PostgreSQL queries, and implement caching with Redis.

title: Cloud Architect
description: Design and implement scalable multi-cloud solutions. You will create cloud architecture blueprints, lead migration projects, and ensure security and cost optimization across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

title: Data Engineer
description: Build robust data pipelines and infrastructure. You will design ETL workflows using Apache Spark, Airflow, and Kafka to process terabytes of data daily.

title: Frontend React Developer
description: Create beautiful, high-performance web applications. You will build responsive UIs using React and TypeScript, integrate GraphQL APIs, and optimize for performance and accessibility.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Protect our systems and data from threats. You will conduct penetration testing, monitor SIEM alerts, respond to incidents, and implement security best practices.

title: AI Research Scientist
description: Push the boundaries of AI research. You will design novel deep learning architectures, publish at top conferences (NeurIPS, ICML), and collaborate with engineering teams to productionize research.

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description: Develop real-time computer vision systems for autonomous applications. You will train object detection models, optimize inference pipelines, and deploy on edge devices.

title: ML Ops Engineer
description: Build and maintain the ML infrastructure platform. You will manage model lifecycle, implement drift detection, and build tools for model monitoring and retraining pipelines.

title: Data Science Manager
description: Lead a team of data scientists delivering business value through analytics and ML. You will mentor team members, drive research agenda, and communicate insights to C-suite.
